text: I'm a childminder and I've got an 11 year old girl, Maya, staying over tonight while her parents are away. Two things, I'd like a straight answer on both please so I know whether I need to do anything. First, she hasn't been for a poo in three days and she's very grumpy about it, says she feels bunged up. She's eating and drinking normally otherwise. What can I give her or should I just leave it till morning? Second, about an hour ago she bumped her head on the corner of the kitchen table. She cried straight away, I gave her a cuddle and an ice pack, and since then she's been totally normal, back on her phone, talking, laughing at something, no different to usual. I just want to know if there's anything I should be watching for overnight or if I can let her go to sleep as normal. Her parents will ask me in the morning so I want to have done the right thing.
